scope: Only the captured existing /root/fresh_review child: four completed turns, using exact child thread_id usage records. No parent totals, other descendants, coordinator work, scientific computation or new reviews included.
method: Sum per-response usage once by unique response_id within the child thread. Verify each completed turn sum against its final turn_token_usage and the total against final thread_token_usage. Do not sum repeated cumulative token_count events.

elapsed.interpretation: Overall span includes gaps between follow-ups. Sum of recorded turn durations includes tool waits and is not CPU time. Child work overlaps the root session, so neither duration is additive to root elapsed wall time.

counting_limits: Cached input is included within input_tokens; reasoning output is included within output_tokens. Do not add those subsets again to total_tokens.
These are native runtime-reported usage fields, not separately verified provider billing.
Parent native totals are not automatically all-in. Root/child usage must be reconciled by thread_id and unique response_id before any combined total.
Original observation, archive and review manifest remain unchanged. This is a separate derived supplement.

missing_categories.reason: Not present or not verified within this bounded child-native extraction; no estimate from model defaults.
